customer_message.subject: Night-time heating problem, Brunnenrain 40, Langenthal
customer_message.body:
Policy holder: Eleanor Gallagher
Address of rented property: Brunnenrain 40, 4.5-room flat, Langenthal
Landlord / manager: Verwaltung Emme & Söhne

Description of the problem:
Every night at some point the boiler switches itself off. When we get up, the bedrooms are cold, about 16 degrees on the thermometer by the bed, and they only warm up again around midday once someone has gone down to the cellar and pressed the reset button. This has been happening since the second half of August. I reported it to Verwaltung Emme & Söhne by phone twice.

Effect on the household:
My partner has rheumatoid arthritis. Since the mornings started being this cold her joints ache far more than usual and she struggles to get going until the flat warms up. Her rheumatologist has told her the cold mornings are clearly making it worse.

Further information:
The cause is not in dispute and nobody thinks we need an expert to look at it. The plumber who came once for the building's hot water said it is the ignition unit of the boiler, a known part, it just needs to be ordered and fitted. The management simply has not given the order.

What I would like from you:
Advice on how to make the landlord act before the winter, and what you need from me.
